params.burnRouter_: Initial LAYER burn router (already pointed at LAYER).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

processFees(address).details: `treasury` and `rewardsReceiver` simply receive the ERC20         transfer. `burnRouter` receives the burn share — for LAYER         this means a direct burn (the router exposes `processBurnLayer`         permissionlessly); for WETH (or other tokens) the router will         later swap them for LAYER and burn.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setBurnRouter(address).details: The new router must report the same `layerToken` as the current         one (sanity check guarding against pointing at a wrong-LAYER         processor). If `IBurnRouter(newRouter).layerToken()` reverts,         this call reverts too — by design.

setSplit(uint16,uint16,uint16).details: Bounds:           - treasuryBps_ ≥ 4000           - burnBps_ ≥ 2000           - rewardsBps_ ≤ 2500           - sum == 10_000         Setting `rewardsBps_ > 0` requires `rewardsReceiver != 0`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

adminRescue(address,address,uint256).notice: Admin-only escape hatch for tokens that get stuck or arrive in         error (e.g. someone transfers an unrelated NFT-claim token).

adminRescueEth(address,uint256).notice: Admin-only escape hatch for ETH sent here as flat deploy fees         or accidental transfers. ERC20 fee processing is unchanged.

burnBps().notice: LAYER burn share of incoming fees, in bps. Default 4000 (40%).

burnRouter().notice: The LAYER BurnRouter. May be replaced (e.g. for upgrades) — the         new router must report the same `layerToken` as the current one         (or the controller is being initialized and there is no current         router yet).

processFees(address).notice: Forwards this contract's balance of `token` to the three sinks         per the active split. Permissionless. Reverts if balance is 0.

setBurnRouter(address).notice: Updates the LAYER burn router. Admin only.

setRewardsReceiver(address).notice: Sets the supporter-rewards receiver. Admin only. Pass `address(0)`         to disable rewards (also forces `rewardsBps == 0`).

setSplit(uint16,uint16,uint16).notice: Updates the split among treasury / burn / rewards. Admin only.

setTreasury(address).notice: Updates the protocol treasury. Admin only.

treasuryBps().notice: Treasury share of incoming fees, in bps. Default 6000 (60%).
